ब: ब 1. ब, the twenty-third consonant of the Nāgarī alphabet and the third of the labial class, often confounded with the semivowel व्, with which some grammarians consider it optionally interchangeable. —ब-कार, अस्, m. the letter or sound ब।
ब 2. ब, अस्, m. a N. of Varuṇa; water; a water-jar. According to lexicographers ब also = भग, गन्धन, वपन, &c.
बंह्: बंह् बंह्, also written वंह् (related to 2. बृह्), cl. 1. A. बंहते, बबंहे, बं-हिता, &c., to grow, increase: Caus. P. बंहयति, यितुम्, to cause to grow, increase, strengthen, fix, make firm; [cf. बहल, बहु, बहुल।]
बंहिमन्: बंहिमन्, आ, m. muchness, abundance, multitude.
बंहिष्ठ: बंहिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम् (superl. of बहुल), very much, very many, most abundant, very abundant, very great, excessive.
बंहीयस्: बंहीयस्, आन्, असी, अस् (compar. of बहुल), much more, more abundant, very many, exceeding.
बकुर: बकुर बकुर, अस्, m., Ved. (according to native authorities), a thunderbolt, lightning, anything shining; perhaps ‘a horn, trumpet, or other wind instrument used in battle;’ [cf. बाकुर, बेकुरा।]
बगदाद: बगदाद बगदाद, N. of a city, Bagdad.
बङ्ग: बङ्ग बङ्ग, अस्, m. the country of Bengal; (usually written वङ्ग, q. v.)
बङ्गाल: बङ्गाल, अस्, m. (?), N. of the country Bengal.
बज: बज बज, अस्, m., Ved. (probably) N. of a herb used as a charm against evil spirits.
बट्: बट् बट्, ind. (perhaps connected with वाढम्, q. v.), Ved. (a particle of affirmation), in truth, certainly (Sāy. = सत्यम्); [cf. Zend bāṭ, bā.]
बठ्: बठ् बठ् = rt. वठ्, q. v.
बडपिला: बडपिला बडपिला, f., N. of a village.
बडवा: बडवा बडवा, f. a mare; the nymph Aśvinī or the personification of the asterism repre-sented by a horse's head; a female slave. —बड-वाग्नि (°वा-अग्°), इस्, or बडवानल (°वा-अन्°), अस्, m. submarine fire; (in mythology) a being consisting of flame but with the head of a mare, fabled to have sprung from the thighs of Urvā and to have been received by the ocean. —बडवा-मुख, अस्, m. submarine fire; (अम्), n. the infernal regions. —ब-डवा-सुत, औ, m. du. the two sons of Aśvinī, (see अश्विन्, अश्विनी-कुमार।) —बडवा-हृत (?), अस्, m. the paramour of a female slave, a slave.
बडा: बडा बडा or बऌआ, ind., Ved. = बट्, q. v.
बडाह: बडाह बडाह, अस्, m., N. of a prince.
बण्: बण् बण् = rt. वण्, q. v.
बणिज्: बणिज् बणिज्, क्, m. (connected with the Vedic पणि fr. rt. 2. पण्, q. v.; but in Ved. and later Sanskrit often written वणिज्), a merchant, (कु-बणिज्, a wicked merchant); a trader; the sixth of the astrono-mical periods called Karaṇa, corresponding to the half of a lunar day; (क्), f. trade, traffic. —बणिक्-पथ, अस्, अम्, m. n. ‘a trader's path or line,’ traffic, com-merce; (अस्), m. a merchant. —बणिक्-पुत्र, अस्, m. a merchant's son, son of a trader, a young mer-chant or trader; (ई), f. a merchant's daughter, a young woman of the merchant class. —बणिग्-बन्-धु, उस्, m. ‘trader's friend,’ the indigo plant, Indi-gofera Tinctoria. —बणिग्-भाव, अस्, अम्, m. n. the state of being a merchant, traffic, trade, commerce. —बणिग्-वह, अस्, m. ‘carrying merchants,’ a camel.
बणिज्य: बणिज्य, अम्, आ, n. f. (for बाणिज्य), trade, traffic.
बण्ड: बण्ड बण्ड, अस्, आ, अम्। See वण्ड।
बत: बत 1. बत, ind. (in the later language वत), Ved. an interjection of astonishment, sorrow, or regret, generally translatable by ah! oh! O! alas! alack! wo! woe! (the word बत seems originally to have stood immediately after the idea beginning the sentence and giving rise to the interjection, e. g. बतो बतासि यम, alas! thou art a weak person, O Yama.) According to native lexicographers the senses in which बत may be used are expressed by the following Sanskrit words, खेद, अनु-कम्प, अनु-क्रोश, वि-स्मय, आश्चर्य, सन्-तोष, धृति, आ-मन्त्रण, निन्दा, सम्-बोधन।
बत 2. बत, अस्, m. (probably for वत, past pass. part. of rt. वन्, q. v.), Ved. (according to the Nirukta) a weak or feeble person.
बद्: बद् बद् or बन्द्, cl. 1. P. बदति, बन्-दति, बबाद, बदितुम्, &c., to be steady, to be firm; [cf. rt. 1. पद्।]
बदर: बदर बदर, अस्, m. (later also वदर), the jujube tree, Zizyphus Jujuba or Z. Scandens; a kind of mustard (= देव-सर्षप); the kernel of the fruit of the cotton plant; N. of a man [cf. बादरायण]; (आ), f., N. of various plants; the cotton shrub; a particular species of bulbous plant (= गृष्टि, वाराही); Mimosa Octandra (= एला-पर्णी); Clitoria Ternatea (= विष्णु-क्रान्ता); (ई), f. the jujube tree; the cotton shrub; Mucuna Pruritus (= कपि-कच्छु); N. of one of the sources of the Gaṅgā and of the hermitage of Nara and Nārāyaṇa situated near it [cf. बदरिका]; (अम्), n. the edible fruit of the jujube; the berry or pod of the cotton shrub; the same berry used as a weight. —बदर-कुण, अस्, m. the time when the fruit of the jujube becomes ripe. —बदर-पाचन, अम्, n., N. of a sacred bathing-place (‘where the jujube ripens’). —ब-दर-फली, f. a species of jujube tree (= भू-ब-दरी). —बदर-यूष, a decoction of the fruit of the jujube. —बदरामलक (°र-आम्°), अम्, n. Flacourtia Cataphracta (probably the fruit rather than the plant itself). —बदरी-च्छद, अस्, आ, m. f. a kind of perfume (apparently a dried shell-fish, = शङ्ख-नखी); (आ), f. a species of jujube tree (= हस्ति-कोलि). —बदरी-तपोवन, अम्, n. the penance grove or hermitage at Badarī. —बदरी-नाथ, अस्, m., N. of a temple at Badarī. —बदरी-नारायण, N. of a place. —बदरी-पत्त्र, अस्, m. a kind of perfume (= नखी). —बदरीपत्त्रक, अम्, n. a kind of perfume, a leaf. —बदरी-पाचन = बदर-पाचन, q. v. —बदरी-प्रस्थ, अस्, m., N. of a city. —बदरी-फल, अम्, n. the fruit of the jujube tree; (आ), f., N. of a plant, a variety of Śephālikā or Nyctanthes with blue flowers. —ब-दरी-मूल, अम्, n. the root of the jujube tree. —बदरी-वण or बदरी-वन, अम्, n. a wood of jujube trees; N. of a place. —बदरी-वासा, f. ‘dwelling at Badarī,’ an epithet of Durgā. —बदरी-शैल, अस्, m. ‘rock of Badarī,’ N. of a rocky emi-nence at the source of the Gaṅgā in the Himālaya range (a celebrated place of pilgrimage, the Bhadri-nāth of modern travellers; or a town and temple on the west bank of the Alaka-nandā river, in the province of Śrī-nagar).
बदरि: बदरि, इस्, f. = बदरी, the jujube tree.
बदरिका: बदरिका, f. (fr. बदरा), the fruit of the jujube (?); N. of one of the sources of the Gaṅgā and of the neighbouring hermitage of Nara and Nārāyaṇa (= बदरी). —बदरिकाश्रम (°का-आश्°), N. of a hermitage.
बद्ध: बद्ध बद्ध। See under rt. बन्ध्, col. 2.

बद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, bound, tied, fixed, fastened; chained, enchained, fettered; fastened or tied round, bound on, put on, girt on, dressed; caught, captured, confined, imprisoned; shut, stopped, closed, pre-cluded; arrested, held back, checked, restrained, suppressed, withheld; joined, connected, combined, united; formed, constructed, built, embanked; inlaid, studded [cf. रीति-ब्°, लोह-ब्°]; composed (as verses); effected, produced; directed towards; formed, set (as fruit); struck (as a root); firmly rooted, firm; placed side by side (as the hollowed hands); clenched (as the fist); knit (as the brows); contracted (as friend-ship or enmity); taken up (as an abode); mani-fested, evinced, displayed; entertained, cherished, fostered, possessed, got; entangled, involved, en-meshed; congealed, clotted (as blood; opposed to द्रव, q. v.); (at the beginning of adj. comps. बद्ध has often a vague sense analogous to that of जात, q. v.; see examples below); (अस् or अम्), m. or n.?, (with Jainas) that which binds or fetters the embodied spirit (viz. connection of the soul with deeds; it consists in a succession of births and deaths as the result of works). —बद्ध-कक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has the loins girt, girt about the loins, having a tightened girdle. —बद्ध-कक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, having the girdle bound or girt up, prepared, ready. —बद्ध-कट, अस्, आ, अम्, made of plaited grass. —बद्ध-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose desires are restrained. —बद्ध-केसर, अस्, आ, अम्, having hair formed, forming hair. —बद्ध-कोप, अस्, आ, अम्, having anger suppressed, smother-ing resentment, governing wrath. —बद्ध-गुद, अम्, n. a dangerous kind of obstruction of the bowels. —बद्धगुदिन्, ई, इनी, इ, suffering from the above obstruction. —बद्ध-गोधाङ्गुलित्र-वत् (°धा-अङ्°), आन्, अती, अत्, (in archery) having fastened a leathern guard on the left arm and fingers; [cf. गो-धा।] —बद्धगोधाङ्गुलि-त्राण, अस्, आ, अम्, having fastened on a leathern guard for the left arm and fingers. —बद्ध-घण्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, having bells bound on. —बद्ध-चित्त, अस्, आ, अम्, having the thoughts fixed, rivetting the mind. —बद्ध-जिह्व, अस्, आ, अम्, tongue-tied, moving the tongue with difficulty. —बद्ध-ज्ञ-ता, f. the state of having acquired knowledge, great knowledge. —बद्ध-तल, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has put on a leathern guard (for the left arm). —बद्ध-तूण, अस्, आ, अम्, having a quiver fas-tened on, girt with a quiver. —बद्ध-दृष्टि, इस्, इस्, इ, having the eyes fixed, fixing the gaze (upon anything). —बद्ध-द्विरद-सेतु, उस्, उस्, उस्, hav-ing elephants bound together for bridges. —बद्-ध-द्वेष, अस्, आ, अम्, contracting hatred. —बद्-ध-धारा-प्रवाह, अस्, आ, अम्, checking the flow of (tear) drops. —बद्ध-निश्चय, अस्, आ, अम्, having a firm conviction, forming a firm resolve, firmly resolved. —बद्ध-निस्तृंश, अस्, आ, अम्, girt with a falchion. —बद्ध-नेत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, having the eyes fixed, fixing the eyes (upon any-thing). —बद्ध-नेपथ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, attired in a theatrical costume. —बद्ध-पङ्क-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having the mud dried or hardened. —बद्-ध-पुरीष, अस्, आ, अम्, having the bowels ob-structed or constipated. —बद्धपुरीष-त्व, अम्, n. the state of being constipated, obstruction of the bowels. —बद्ध-प्रतिज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has contracted an engagement, one who has made a vow or promise. —बद्ध-प्रतिश्रुत्, त्, त्, त्, in which echoes are formed, resonant with echoing sounds. —बद्ध-फल, अस्, m. the plant Pon-gamia Glabra (= करञ्ज). —बद्ध-भाव, अस्, आ, अम्, having the mind or heart fixed. —बद्ध-भीमान्धकार (°म-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, enveloped in terrible darkness. —बद्ध-भू, ऊस्, f. the lowest floor (‘fixed on the ground’); ground pre-pared for the site of a house. —बद्ध-भूमिक, अस्, आ, अम्, having an inlaid floor. —बद्ध-मुख, अस्, ई, अम्, having the mouth or orifice closed. —बद्ध-मुष्टि, इस्, इस्, इ, having a closed fist; close-fisted, griping, penurious, covetous; [cf. दृढ-मुष्टि।] —बद्धमुष्टि-कर, अस्, m. the hand with closed fist. —बद्धमुष्टि-त्व, अम्, n. the state of having the fist closed (for holding a bow). —बद्-ध-मूत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, stopping or obstructing the urine. —बद्ध-मूल, अस्, आ, अम्, striking root firmly, deeply rooted. —बद्धमूल-ता, f. the state of being firmly rooted. —बद्ध-मौन, अस्, आ, अम्, one by whom silence is observed, keeping silence. —बद्ध-रभस, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has formed an ardent attachment, passionately attached (to any one). —बद्ध-रसाल, अस्, m. a species of mango (the most highly prized kind). —बद्ध-राग, अस्, आ, अम्, filled with passion, impassioned. —बद्ध-राज्य, अस्, आ, अम्, having attained to royalty. —बद्-ध-वत्सा, f., scil. गौस्, a cow whose calf is tied up (in the stall). —बद्ध-वन्दन-मालक, अस्, इका, अम्, having fastened garlands in token of wel-come. —बद्ध-वर्चस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, constipating the bowels. —बद्ध-वसति, इस्, इस्, इ, fixing an abode. —बद्ध-वाच्, क्, क्, क्, suppressing the voice, maintaining silence, taciturn. —बद्धविट्क, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. बद्ध + विष्), one whose bowels are constipated, costive. —बद्धविट्क-ता, f. con-stipation of the bowels, costiveness. —बद्ध-विण्-मूत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, obstructing the evacuations by stool and by the bladder. —बद्ध-वीर, अस्, आ, अम्, whose heroes or soldiers are bound. —बद्ध-वेपथु, उस्, उस्, उ, seized with tremor, trembling. —बद्ध-वैर, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has con-tracted great enmity or confirmed hostility, feeling bitter hatred. —बद्ध-शस्, an incorrect form for बद्व-शस्, q. v. —बद्ध-शिख, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose hair is tied up into a single lock upon the crown of the head; one who is still in childhood, young, a child, a pupil (not yet tonsured); (आ), f. a sort of pungent root, (according to some) a kind of garlic. —बद्ध-श्रोत्र-मनश्-चक्षुस्, उस्, उस्, उस्, having the ears, mind, and eyes fixed; fixing the ears, mind, and eyes. —बद्ध-सूत, अस्, m. a par-ticular preparation of quicksilver. —बद्ध-स्नेह, अस्, आ, अम्, forming an attachment, conceiving affection for (with loc.). —बद्धाङ्गुलि-त्र or बद्धाङ्-गुलि-त्राण (°ध-अङ्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having a finger-guard fastened on, equipped with gauntlets. —बद्-धाञ्जलि (°ध-अञ्°), इस्, इस्, इ, having the hands hollowed and placed side by side, with hands or palms joined in humble entreaty, putting the joined hands to the forehead, saluting respectfully; with closed hands. —बद्धाञ्जलि-पुट, अस्, आ, अम्, forming a cup with the hollowed hands. —बद्-धात्मन् (°ध-आत्°), आ, m. (with Jainas) a soul which is bound or fettered by deeds and works previous to its deliverance. —बद्धानन्द (°ध-आन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, feeling pleasure, joyful. —बद्धा-नुराग (°ध-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, manifesting love, feeling affection. —बद्धानुशय (°ध-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, one whose purpose is fixed, of fixed intent; taking aim. —बद्धाम्बरचर-मार्ग (°ध-अम्°), अस्, आ, अम्, obstructing the path of birds (said of a conflagration). —बद्धायुध (°ध-आय्°), अस्, आ, अम्, accoutred with arms. —बद्धा-शङ्क (°ध-आश्°), अस्, आ, अम्, one whose suspicions are raised, apprehensive. —बद्धोत्सव (°ध-उत्°), अस्, आ, अम्, observing a festival, enjoying a holiday. —बद्धोद्यम (°ध-उद्°), अस्, आ, अम्, uniting efforts, making united efforts, having the energies intently fixed.
बद्धप्पि: बद्धप्पि बद्ध-प्पि, n. (perhaps a Prākṛt form for बद्ध-पाणि), the clasped hand, the fist; (also read बद्धापि।)
बध्: बध् 1. बध्, to bind, for बन्ध्, col. 2.
बध् 2. बध्, used only in Desid. A. बी-भत्सते, to abhor, detest, &c. See बीभत्स (which is by some considered to belong to rt. बाध्).
बध् 3. बध् for वध्, to kill, &c., sub-stituted in some tenses of rt. हन्। See वध् and हन्।
बध: बध, अस्, m. killing, murder, &c.; see वध। —बध-काङ्क्षिन्, for this and all other com-pounds of बध see under वध।
बधिर: बधिर, अस्, आ, अम्, deaf, (sometimes written वधिर); [cf. Hib. bodhar; Cambro-Brit. byzar; Armor. byzar.] —बधिर-ता, f. or बधिर-त्व, अम्, n. deafness. —बधिरान्ध (°र-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, deaf and blind; (अस्), m., N. of a Nāga, son of Kaśyapa. —बधिरी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कु-रुते, -कर्तुम्, to make deaf, deafen. —बधिरी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, made deaf, deafened.
बध्योग: बध्योग बध्योग, अस्, m., N. of a man.
बन्द्: बन्द् बन्द्। See rt. बद्, p. 671, col. 3.
बन्दिआरयु: बन्दिआरयु बन्दिआरयु, N. of a place men-tioned in the Romaka-siddhānta.
बन्ध्: बन्ध् बन्ध् [cf. rt. बुन्ध्], cl. 9. P. (ep. also A.) बध्नाति (बध्नीते), Impv. 2nd sing. बधान, बबन्ध (Ved. 3rd pl. बेधुस्, 2nd sing. A. बेधिषे), भन्त्स्यति (ep. also बन्-धिष्यति, -ते), अभान्त्सीत्, बन्द्धुम् (ep. also बन्-धितुम्), to bind, tie, fix, fasten; to chain, enchain, fetter; to fasten or tie round, bind round, put on (e. g. चीरम् बध्नन्ति मुनयः, the ascetics put on clothing made of strips of bark); (A.) to bind on one's self, put on; to ensnare; to catch (e. g. मत्-स्यान् बन्ध्, to catch fish), take captive, take prisoner; to shut up, confine, imprison; to inflict punishment, punish, chastise; to bind a sacrificial victim, offer, sacrifice (with dat. of the deity to whom the victim is presented, Ved.); to fix, direct, fasten (the eyes or mind) upon (with loc.); to shut, close, stop, stop up, preclude; to arrest, hold back, check, suppress; to overpower, oppress, violate; to bind together, put together, fasten together, join, com-bine, connect, conglomerate, unite; to construct, build; to construct verses, compose; to bring to pass, effect, produce, evoke, result in, be followed by (with acc.); to form fruit (as a plant), to set; to strike (root); to take up (an abode); to manifest, exhibit, evince, display, show (e. g. धृतिम् ब-धान, show thy resolution); to entertain, cherish, foster, possess, have, contract, form; अञ्जलिम् बन्ध्, to place the two hands hollowed side by side; मुष्टिम् बन्ध्, to clench the fist; सेतुम् बन्ध्, to construct a dam, build a bridge, (बन्धिष्ये सेतुना गङ्गाम्, I will span the Gaṅgā with a bridge); गोलम् बन्ध्, to form or construct a globe; भ्रु-कुटिम् बन्ध्, to knit the brows, frown; सौहृद्यम् or सख्यम् or अजर्यम् बन्ध् to contract friendship; वैरम् बन्ध्, to contract enmity: Pass. बध्यते, Aor. अबधि (?), to be bound; to bind on one's self, put on: Caus. बन्-धयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अबबन्धत्, to cause to bind, cause to be bound; to order to be imprisoned; to cause to be joined together or constructed, cause to be built, cause to be embanked; (according to the Dhātu-pāṭha) to bind, (in this last sense also बाधयति): Desid. बिभत्सति, to wish to bind: Intens. बाबध्यते, बाबन्द्धि, to bind fast, tie firmly; [cf. Zend band, banda, baś-ta, ‘bound;’ Gr. πείθω, πεῖσ-μα for πενθ-μα, πενθερός; Lat. pat-ibulum, pendo, pendeo, fī-lum for fid-lum, fū-nis for fud-nis, fīd-es, fīd-o for feido = πείθω, fœd-us; Slav. vjazati, ‘to bind;’ Goth. bind-an, fastan; Old Germ. fasti; Angl. Sax. bindan, bonda, bœnd, bœst, fœst; Iceland. fas-t.]
बद्धक: बद्धक, अस्, m., Ved. one who is bound, a captive, prisoner.
बद्ध्वा: बद्ध्वा, ind. having bound or tied; having put on; having joined.
बद्व: बद्व, अम्, n., Ved. a large number, multitude; a particular high number, (according to Sāy.) 100 Koṭis, (according to others) 10,000 millions; the number 13084. —बद्व-शस्, ind. in large numbers, in multitudes; (also incorrectly written बद्ध-शस्।)
बद्वन्: बद्वन्, आ, m. a causeway, highway.
बधिरक: बधिरक, अस्, m., N. of a man; (आस्), m. pl., N. of his descendants; (इका), f., N. of a woman.
बधिरय: बधिरय, Nom. P. बधिरयति, -यितुम्, to make deaf, deafen.
बधिरित: बधिरित, अस्, आ, अम्, made deaf, deafened.
बध्नत्: बध्नत्, अन्, अती, अत्, binding, tying; effecting, producing.
बध्र: बध्र, अम्, n. lead; (ई), f. a thong.
बध्र्य: बध्र्य, अम्, n. a shoe, slipper.
बन्ध: बन्ध, अस्, m. binding, tying, a bond, tie, chain, fetter, knot, halter, tether [cf. पाद-ब्°]; a ligature, bandage; laying snares; catching, capturing, capture; binding in fetters, fettering, confining, imprisoning, confinement, imprisonment, custody [cf. राज-ब्°]; fixing, directing (the mind towards anything); bind-ing together, joining, uniting [cf. पाणि-ब्°]; joining the hollowed hands; forming, constructing, construc-tion, building, erecting (e. g. सेतोर् बन्धः, the construction of an embankment or bridge; cf. सेतु-ब्°); embanking, an embankment, throwing a bridge across (a river); contracting or knitting the brows [cf. भ्रुकुटि-ब्°]; joining the hands or feet in particular positions, any posture or position of the limbs or body generally, a position, posture (e. g. आसन-ब्°, a sitting posture); a particular position of the hands and feet [cf. महा-ब्°, मूल-ब्°]; a par-ticular position in coitus; connection, intercourse, society; agreement, union; manifestation, exhibition, display [cf. राग-ब्°]; consequence, result (e. g. अरिष्ट-ब्°, having welfare as a consequence, causing welfare); a sinew, tendon; a pledge, deposit, (per-haps rather) pledging [cf. बन्धक]; that with which anything is bound together or bordered, border, framework, inclosure; (in philosophy) bon-dage, (opposed to मुक्ति, मोक्ष, and regarded in the Sāṅkhya system as threefold, viz. प्रकृति-ब्°, वैकारिक-ब्°, दक्षिणा-ब्°; cf. कर्म-ब्°, दक्-षिणा-ब्°); (in rhetoric) combination of sounds, con-struction of words; a disease in which the eyelids cannot be wholly closed; (in comp. with numerals) a part [cf. दश-ब्°, पञ्च-ब्°; cf. also Lat. pondus; Lith. bandà, ‘a herd of cattle;’ Angl. Sax. bonda, bœnd, bœst; Hib. bad = Armor. bód, ‘a bunch, bush, cluster, tuft, thicket.’] —बन्ध-करण, अम्, n. binding, fettering, restraining, holding back, preventing, impeding. —बन्ध-कर्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, a binder, one who fetters or restrains. —बन्-ध-तन्त्र, अम्, n. a complete army, or one pos-sessing the four divisions of chariots, elephants, horse, and foot. —बन्ध-देश, N. of a country men-tioned in the Ratna-koṣa. —बन्ध-पारुष्य, अम्, n. forced construction of words. —बन्ध-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, consisting of bonds or ties, serving for a bond, being of the nature of a bond. —बन्-ध-मुद्रा, f. the impression or mark of fetters. —बन्ध-मोचनिका or बन्ध-मोचिनी, f. ‘re-leasing from bonds,’ N. of a Yoginī. —बन्ध-स्तम्भ, अस्, m. ‘binding-post,’ the post to which an elephant is tied.
बन्धक: बन्धक, अस्, m. a binder, one who is employed in binding; one who catches, a catcher [cf. नाग-ब्°]; a violator, ravisher; a band, tie [cf. पशु-ब्°]; a bank, dam, dike [cf. जल-ब्°]; any posture of the body [cf. मल्ल-ब्°]; a pledge, deposit, pawn, (perhaps rather) pledging; a promise, vow (= सत्यङ्-कार); exchanging, barter; (in comp. with numerals, espe-cially at the end of an adj. comp.) a part, portion (e. g. ऋणं स-दश-बन्धकम्, a debt plus one tenth); a city; (अम्), n. binding, confinement; (ई), f. an unchaste woman (‘connected with many men;’ कुमार-बन्धकी, a woman unchaste even as a girl); a harlot, courtezan, wanton [cf. बन्धुकी]; a barren woman [cf. बन्ध्या]; a female elephant. —बन्धक-त्व, अम्, n. the being fettered.
बन्धन: बन्धन, अस्, ई, अम्, binding, tying, fettering [cf. भाव-ब्°]; holding fast, arresting, checking, stopping; (at the end of a comp.) dependant on, depending upon; (अम्), n. the act of binding, tying, fastening, fettering; a bond, chain, fetter; a tether, halter; a sinew, muscle [cf. श्लथ-ब्°]; binding on, binding round; binding up; a ligature, bandage; joining, connection; catching, capturing; confining, confinement, captivity, bondage, detention, im-prisonment; a gaol, prison; inflicting pain, hurting; putting to death; joining, connecting, uniting; forming, building, constructing, construction; सेतोर् बन्धनम्, the construction of an embankment or bridge [cf. सेतु-बन्ध, सेतु-बन्धन]; a bar, barrier; embanking, an embankment, bridging over; mixing, alloying, alloyage (of metals); con-junction, connection, coherence; a stalk, stem, pe-duncle [cf. प्रसव-ब्°]; गीत-बन्धन, a com-position which is sung, an epic poem rehearsed in singing; (अम्, ई), n. f. any instrument of binding or holding together, a bond (e. g. अन्नम् प्राणस्य बन्धनम्, food is the bond, i. e. the staff of life), band, rope, tie, cord, string, garter, thread; a tether, halter [cf. पाद-ब्°]; a chain, fetter; a snare; a ligature, bandage. —बन्धन-ग्रन्थि, इस्, m. the knot of a ligature; a noose; a rope for tying cattle. —बन्धन-पालक, अस्, m. a gaol-keeper, gaoler, turnkey. —बन्धन-रज्जु, उस्, f. a rope for tying cattle; any rope or string used for tying. —बन्धन-वेश्मन्, अ, n. ‘house of bondage,’ a prison. —बन्धन-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, being in prison, living in confinement, imprisoned, captive; (अस्), m. a prisoner, captive. —बन्धन-स्थान, अम्, n. (a place where cattle are fastened), a stall, stable. —बन्धनागार (°न-अग्° or -आग्°), अस्, अम्, m. n. ‘house of bondage,’ a prison. —बन्-धनाधिकार (°न-अध्°), अस्, m., N. of the third chapter of the first part of the Rasendra-kalpa-druma, a medical work by Rāma-kṛṣṇa. —बन्धनालय (°न-आल्°), अम्, n. ‘house of bondage,’ a prison.
बन्धनीय: बन्धनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be bound or tied, to be bound on, to be bound round; anything bound on or tied round; to be confined, to be captured or taken prisoner; to be embanked; (अस्), m. (accord-ing to a Scholiast) = सेतु, an embankment.
बन्धयितृ: बन्धयितृ, ता, m. one who binds or ties up, a binder.
बन्धित: बन्धित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to be bound (e. g. शतम् बन्धितः, caused to be bound for a hundred pieces of money, i. e. imprisoned for a debt of a hundred pieces of money); bound.
बन्धित्र: बन्धित्र, अम्, n. (?), the god of love, love, desire [cf. वधित्र]; a spot, mole.
बन्धिन्: बन्धिन्, ई, इनी, इ, (at the end of a comp.) binding [cf. दृढ-बन्धिनी]; catching [cf. मत्स्य-ब्°]; causing, effecting, producing, exciting, evoking [cf. फल-ब्°, राग-ब्°]; showing, exhibiting, manifest-ing, evincing [cf. वात्सल्य-ब्°].
बन्धु: बन्धु, उस्, m. connection, conjunction, relation-ship, association; relation, reference, respect (e. g. केन बन्धुना, in what respect ?); one who is connected with or belongs to (any profession or tribe, especially if only nominally so connected; cf. क्ष-त्र-ब्°, द्विज-ब्°, ब्रह्म-ब्°); a kinsman, relation, relative, connection, kindred in general [cf. मातृ-ब्°]; (in law) a cognate kinsman in a remote degree, one subsequent in right of inheritance to the Sa-gotra, (three kinds of these are enumerated, personal, pater-nal, and maternal: the first are sons of the deceased father's sister, of his mother's sister, and of his ma-ternal uncle: the second are the sons of his father's paternal aunt, of his father's maternal aunt, and of his father's maternal uncle: the third are the sons of his mother's paternal aunt, of his mother's ma-ternal aunt, and of his mother's maternal uncle); a friend [cf. अ-ब्°, अमृत-ब्°, ऋषि-ब्°]; a husband; a brother; N. of a flower (= बन्धूक); N. of a metre; (in astron.) N. of the fourth mansion; N. of a Ṛṣi with the patronymic Gaupāyana or Lau-pāyana, author of two hymns in the Ṛg-veda; (ac-cording to Yāska also) wealth; according to Pāṇini a feminine word ending in या must change या to ई before बन्धु in a comp., e. g. कारीष-गन्ध्या-बन्धु becomes कारीष-गन्धी-बन्धु; [cf. Hib. badh, ‘love, friendship.’] —बन्धु-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, loving relations, affectionate towards relations and friends. —बन्धु-कृत्य, अम्, n. the duty of a kinsman or of a friend, a friendly office, friendly service. —बन्धु-क्षित्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. dwelling among rela-tions; (Sāy.) having the quality or condition of kin-dred; (according to some this word may be the N. of a person or family.) —बन्धु-जन, अस्, m. a kinsman, relation, friend; kinsfolk, relations. —बन्-धु-जीव or बन्धु-जीवक, अस्, m. ‘living in associ-ation or groups,’ Pentapetes Phœnicea, (a plant with a red flower which opens at midday and withers away the next morning at sunrise); (अम्), n. its flower; (कस्), m., N. of a Cakra-vartin. —बन्धुजीव-पुष्प, अम्, n. the flower of Pentapetes Phœnicea. —बन्धुजीवाभि-ताम्र (°व-अभ्°), अस्, आ, अम्, deep red like the blossom of Pentapetes Phœnicea. —बन्धु-ता, f. relations collectively, kindred, kin (= बन्धूनां समूहः); relationship, affinity, connection, relation. —बन्धु-त्व, अम्, n. relation-ship, brotherhood, affinity. —बन्धु-दग्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘destroyed or consumed by relations,’ i. e. an abandoned wretch (= हतक). —बन्धु-दत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, given by relations or by a kinsman; (अस्), m., N. of a man; (आ), f., N. of a woman; (अम्), n. a particular kind of female property (given to a girl by her relations at her marriage). —बन्धु-दायाद, अस्, m. a kinsman and heir. —बन्धु-पति, इस्, m. lord of kindred or relations; [cf. बान्धुपत।] —बन्धु-पाल, अस्, m. ‘kindred-protector,’ N. of a man. —बन्धु-पालित, अस्, m. ‘kindred-pro-tected,’ N. of a prince. —बन्धु-पुष्प-माल, अस्, आ, अम्, wearing a chaplet of Bandhu flowers. —बन्-धु-पृछ्, ट्, m., Ved. asking relations, inquiring after kindred, (Sāy. = बन्धूनाम् प्रष्टा); [cf. पृष्-ट-बन्धु।] —बन्धु-प्रभ, अस्, m., N. of a Vidyā-dhara. —बन्धु-प्रीति, इस्, f. affection for a friend, love of relatives or friends. —बन्धु-भाव, अस्, m. friendship. —बन्धु-भाषित, अम्, n. the talk or speech of kindred. —बन्धु-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having relations, surrounded by relations; (आन्), m., N. of a man; of a king; (अती), f., N. of two women; N. of a town. —बन्धु-वञ्चक, अस्, m. ‘deceiver of relatives,’ N. of a Vidūṣaka. —बन्धु-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having relations or kindred. —बन्-धु-वर्ग, अस्, m. the whole body of relations, circle of kinsmen, kindred. —बन्धु-हीन, अस्, आ, अम्, destitute of kindred, relationless, friendless. —बन्-धू-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, -कर्तुम्, to make a friend of. —बन्धू-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, made a friend. —बन्ध्व्-एष, अस्, m., Ved. inquiring after kin-dred, (Sāy. = बन्धूनाम् अन्वेषणम्।)
बन्धुक: बन्धुक, अस्, m. a species of plant (= बन्-धूक, बन्धु-जीव); a bastard [cf. बन्धुल]; (आ, ई), f. an unchaste woman (= बन्धकी).
बन्धुकिन्: बन्धुकिन्, ई, इनी, इ, coming from or belonging to an unchaste woman.
बन्धुदा: बन्धुदा, f. an unchaste woman; (perhaps wrongly for बन्धुरा।)
बन्धुर: बन्धुर, अस्, आ, अम्, uneven, undulating, fluc-tuating, wavy; bowed, bent, inclined, depressed, crooked; pleasing, delightful, handsome, beautiful; deaf; injurious, mischievous; (अस्), m. a goose; a crane; a drug (= विडङ्ग ऋषभ); a plant (= बन्धूक); oil-cake; the vulva; (आ), f. a prostitute; (आस्), f. pl. the meal of parched corn; (अम्), n. a diadem, crest; [cf. Angl. Sax. bendan.]
बन्धुरित: बन्धुरित, अस्, आ, अम्, bent, inclined, depressed.
बन्धुल: बन्धुल, अस्, आ, अम्, bent, inclined, depressed; pleasing, charming; (अस्), m. an attendant in the chamber of a harlot; the son of a harlot, a bastard; Pentapetes Phœnicea; N. of a Ṛṣi. —बन्धुलान्-वय (°ल-अन्°), अस्, m. the posterity of Bandhula.
बन्धूक: बन्धूक, अस्, m. a shrub bearing a red flower, Pentapetes Phœnicea [cf. बन्धु-जीव]; Terminalia Tomentosa; (अम्), n. the flower of Pentapetes Phœ-nicea. —बन्धूक-पुष्प, अस्, m. the tree Termi-nalia Tomentosa. —बन्धूकपुष्प-रजस्, अस्, n. the pollen of the above flower.
बन्धूर: बन्धूर, अस्, आ, अम्, wavy, undulating, uneven; bowing, bent; beautiful; (अस्), m. a hole, a chasm.
बन्धूलि: बन्धूलि, इस्, m. a plant (= बन्धूक).
बन्ध्य: बन्ध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be bound or fettered, to be confined or imprisoned; to be bound together, to be joined; to be constructed; detained, confined, under arrest; stopped; not bearing fruit in due season, barren, unfruitful, unproductive, fruitless, idle, useless, unprofitable, vain; not having the menstrual courses; destitute, deprived of (with inst. or at the end of a comp., e. g. प्रजा-ब्°, destitute of offspring); (आ), f. a barren or childless woman; a barren cow; a kind of perfume commonly called Bāla. —बन्-ध्य-ता, f. or बन्ध्य-त्व, अम्, n. barrenness, sterility, uselessness; want, deficiency, scarcity, desti-tution. —बन्ध्य-पर्वत, N. of a district. —बन्-ध्य-फल, अस्, आ, अम्, fruitless, useless, idle, vain. —बन्ध्यफल-ता, f. fruitlessness, uselessness. —बन्ध्या-कर्कोटकी, f. a species of medicinal plant given to barren women; [cf. पुत्र-दा।] —बन्ध्या-तनय, अस्, m. = बन्ध्या-पुत्र, q. v. —बन्ध्या-त्व, अम्, n. sterility, barrenness. —बन्ध्या-दुहितृ, ता, f. the daughter of a barren woman, a mere chimæra or anything merely ima-ginary which does not really exist. —बन्ध्या-पुत्र, अस्, m. the son of a barren woman, i. e. any-thing merely imaginary, an impossibility; [cf. ग-गण-पुष्प।] —बन्ध्या-रोग, अस्, m., N. of a chapter of the Prayogāmṛta, a medical work by Vaidya-cintāmaṇi. —बन्ध्या-सुत, अस्, or बन्-ध्या-सूनु, उस्, m. = बन्ध्या-पुत्र, q. v.
बन्ध्यायमान: बन्ध्यायमान, अस्, आ, अम्, becoming barren or useless.
बन्ध्र: बन्ध्र or बन्द्ध्र, अम्, n. a band, tie, (in अ-ब्°, q. v.)
बफार: बफार बफार, N. of a place.
बबकाण: बबकाण बबकाण, N. of a place.
बबबा: बबबा बबबा, ind., Ved. an onomato-poetic word expressive of the crackling of fire.
बबर: बबर बबर, अस्, m., N. of a man; N. of a place; (also read ववर।)
बबाड: बबाड बबाड, अस्, m., N. of a village.
बबूआण: बबूआण बबूआण, N. of a place.
बभ्र: बभ्र बभ्र (fr. rt. भृ with reduplication) in प्र-बभ्र, q. v.
बभ्रि: बभ्रि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. bearing, carrying, wielding, taking, (Sāy. = भर्तृ, धारक); (in Atharva-veda XI. 1, 31 sqq., either ‘nourishing’ or a various reading for बभ्रु, q. v.)
बभ्रु: बभ्रु बभ्रु, उस्, उस्, or ऊस्, उ (said to be a reduplicated form of rt. भृ), deep brown, brown, tawny, tan-coloured, a mixed brownish colour (vari-ously applied to oxen, to the horses of Indra, of Rudra, and Soma, to plants, to dice formed of nuts, &c.); bald-headed through disease; (उस्), m. a man with deep brown hair, red-haired person; a large kind of ichneumon, an ichneumon generally; the bird Cu-culus Melanoleucus (= चातक); a species of vege-table; an epithet of Kṛṣṇa or Viṣṇu; an epithet of Śiva; fire; N. of various men; of a descendant of Atri with the epithets Daivāvṛdha and Kaumbhya and author of the hymns Ṛg-veda V. 30, 14, VIII. 22, 10; of the author of a Dharma-śāstra; of a disciple of Śaunaka; of a son of Viśvā-mitra; of a son of Viśva-garbha; of a Vṛṣṇi; of a son of Druhyu; of a son of Roma-pāda or Loma-pāda; of a Gandharva; N. of a country [cf. बभ्रु-देश]; (उ), n. a tawny or brown colour; any object of a tawny or brown colour; [cf. Gr. φρΰ-νη, φρῦ-νο-ς, Φρύνη, Φρῦνος, Φρύνιχο-ς, Φρυνίων, Φρυνώνδας; Lat. fur-vu-s, perhaps fu-scu-s; Old Germ. brun = Mod. Germ. braun = Eng. brown.] —बभ्रु-कर्ण, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. brown-eared, having brown ears. —बभ्रु-देश, अस्, m., N. of a country; [cf. बभ्रु।] —बभ्रु-धातु, उस्, m. ‘dark brown mineral,’ a kind of ochre (= सु-वर्ण-गैरिक)। —बभ्रु-धूत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. pressed out or extracted by Babhru (as Soma juice; Sāy. = बभ्रु-णाभिषुतः). —बभ्रु-नीकाश, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. appearing brownish, of a brownish look, (according to Mahī-dhara = कपिल-वर्ण-सदृश।) —ब-भ्रु-पिङ्गल, अस्, आ, अम्, brown and tawny (as an owl). —बभ्रु-मालिन्, ई, m. ‘brown-garlanded,’ N. of a Muni. —बभ्रु-वक्त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘ich-neumon-faced,’ having the face of an ichneumon. —बभ्रु-वाह or बभ्रु-वाहन, अस्, m., N. of a son of Arjuna, king of Mahodaya.
बभ्रवी: बभ्रवी, f. an epithet of Durgā; (an incorrect form for बाभ्रवी।)
बभ्रुक: बभ्रुक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. brownish; (अस्), m. (probably) a kind of ichneumon.
बभ्रुश: बभ्रुश, अस्, आ, अम्, see Gaṇa Lomādi to Pāṇ. V. 2, 100.
बभ्लुश: बभ्लुश, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. brownish, (Mahī-dhara = कपिल-वर्ण; cf. कपिश, कृष्णश।)
बम्ब्: बम्ब् बम्ब्, cl. 1. P. बम्बति, बम्बितुम्, to go.
बम्बगैर: बम्बगैर बम्बगैर, N. of a place.
बम्बुरेवण: बम्बुरेवण बम्बुरेवण, N. of a place.
बम्भर: बम्भर बम्भर, अस्, m. a bee; [cf. भ्र-मर।]
बम्भारि: बम्भारि बम्भारि, इस्, m., Ved., N. of one of the seven tutelary deities of the Soma plant.
बर: बर बर, अस्, m. a N. of Bala-rāma (= बल).
बरट: बरट बरट, अस्, m. a species of grain; [cf. बर्बट।]
बरासी: बरासी बरासी, f. a particular article of clothing or kind of woven cloth; (also read वरासी, वरासि, वराशि।)
बरु: बरु बरु, उस्, m., Ved., N. of a descendant of Aṅgiras and author of the hymn Ṛg-veda X. 96; N. of an Āṅgirasa.
बरोदा: बरोदा बरोदा, N. of a place in Guzerat.
बर्कु: बर्कु बर्कु, उस्, m., Ved., N. of a man with the patronymic Vārṣṇa.
बर्जर: बर्जर बर्जर, N. of a place.
बर्जह: बर्जह बर्जह, अस्, अम्, m. n., Ved. an udder, (Sāy. = पयस उत्पत्ति-स्थानम्।)
बर्जह्य: बर्जह्य, अम्, n., Ved. a nipple.
बर्ब्: बर्ब् बर्ब्, cl. 1. P. बर्बति, बर्बितुम्, to go, move.
बर्बट: बर्बट बर्बट, अस्, ई, m. f. a kind of bean, Dolichos Catjang [cf. बरट]; (ई), f. a harlot, pros-titute; [cf. बार्बटीर।]
बर्बणा: बर्बणा बर्बणा, f. (said to be fr. rt. बर्ब्), a blue fly.
बर्बर: बर्बर बर्बर, अस्, m. (also written वर्-वर, q. v., cf. βάρβαρος), a blockhead, fool, low fel-low, barbarian, any one not a Sanskrit speaker, not an Āryan, (used mostly in the voc.); (अस् or अम्), m. or n. (?), N. of a district. —बर्बर-ता, f. (in Ved. gram.) a stammering pronunciation of the letter र्। —बर्बर-स्थान, N. of a district.
बर्बुर: बर्बुर बर्बुर, अम्, n., Ved. water; [cf. Gr. βόρβορο-ν; Fr. bourbe.]
बर्स: बर्स बर्स, अस्, m., Ved. a tip, point, thin end, extremity. —बर्स-नद्धि, इस्, f., Ved. the tying of sacrificial knots.
बर्स्व: बर्स्व बर्स्व, अस्, m., Ved. the fleshy forma-tion of the gums round the socket of a tooth, a socket of a tooth.
बर्ह: बर्ह बर्ह् (also written वर्ह्, q. v., cf. rts. बृह्, वृह्, बृंह्, वृंह्), cl. 1. A. बर्हते, बबर्हे, बर्हितुम्, to speak; to hurt, injure, kill; to give, (according to another reading) to cover; to spread, (this sense being perhaps only deduced from बर्हिस्, q. v.); to be pre-eminent or excellent; cl. 10. P. बर्हयति, to hurt, injure, kill.
बर्ह बर्ह, बर्हिन्। See वर्ह, वर्हिन्।
बर्हण: बर्हण बर्हण (fr. rt. बृंह् for वृंह्), Ved. strong; occurring only in the Vedic inst. बर्हणा, closely, firmly, strongly; very, really, certainly. —बर्हण-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, energetic, vigorous, earnest; (according to Sāy.) injuring enemies. —बर्-हणाश्व (°ण-अश्°), अस्, m., N. of a prince, a son of Nikumbha.
बर्हस्: बर्हस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. strong, firm; occurring only in अद्रि-बर्हस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, firm as a rock, fastened by rocks; (or according to Sāy.) spread out or swollen with clouds, and in द्वि-ब्°, q. v.
बर्हिष्ठ: 1. बर्हिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, strongest, &c. See वर्-हिष्ठ। (For 2. बर्हि-ष्ठ see p. 675, col. 1.)
बर्हिस्: बर्हिस् बर्हिस्, इस्, m. n. (in the later litera-ture generally written वर्हिस्; probably fr. rt. 1. or 2. वृह्; said to be fr. rt. वृंह्), (that which is plucked up), a bed or layer of Kuśa grass (usually strewed over the sacrificial ground and especially over the Vedi, to serve as a sacred surface on which to present the oblations, and as a seat for the gods and for the sacrificers); Kuśa grass, sacrificial grass; (इस्), n. the strewed sacrificial grass personified and enumerated among the Pra-yāja and Anu-yāja deities; sacrifice (= तन्त्र); ether; water; a kind of perfume, = बर्हि-पुष्प; (इस्), m. fire, light, lustre, splendor; Plumbago Zeylanica (to which plant all the names of fire are applied); N. of a son of Bṛhad-rāja; (इषस्), m. pl. the descendants of Barhis. —बर्हिः-पुष्प, अम्, n. = बर्हि-पुष्प. —बर्हिः-शुष्-मन्, आ, m. fire, the god of fire. —बर्हिः-षद्, see under बर्हि-षद्. —बर्हिः-ष्ठ, अस्, m. ‘standing upon the sacrificial grass,’ (perhaps) a victim; (अम्), n. a kind of perfume commonly called Bāla; or (according to some) a kind of fragrant grass, Andropogon Muricatus. —बर्हिः-ष्ठा, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. standing or placed upon the sacrificial grass. —बर्हि-कुसुम, अम्, n. = बर्हि-पुष्प। —बर्हि-पुष्प, अम्, n. a kind of perfume. —बर्-हिर्-ज्योतिस्, इस्, m. fire, the deity of fire. —बर्हिर्-मुख, अस्, m. ‘fire-mouthed,’ a deity (so called because sacrifices are mostly offered to the gods by fire). —बर्हि-षद्, त्, त्, त् (बर्हि for बर्हिस् + सद्), seated on sacrificial grass; (according to the Nirukta) = महत्, great; (दस्), m. pl. the Manes; (in the later literature) a particular class of Pitṛs or Manes, see Manu III. 196, 199; (त्), m. a Pitṛ or deified progenitor; N. of a son of Havir-dhāna and Havir-dhānī (= प्राचीन-बर्हिस्). —बर्हि-षद, अस्, m., N. of a holy sage (= बर्हिन्). —बर्हिष्-केश, अस्, m. ‘having light for hair,’ fire, Agni, the god of fire.  — 2. बर्हि-ष्ठ, अम्, n. a kind of fragrant grass or perfume; the resin of the Pinus Longifolia, see बर्हिः-ष्ठ; (for 1. बर्हिष्ठ see p. 674, col. 3.) —बर्हिष्-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessing sacrificial grass, (Sāy. = आस्तीर्णेन बर्हिषा युक्-तः); (आन्), m. one who has or spreads sacrificial grass, a worshipper, sacrificer, (Sāy. = यज्ञेन युक्-तः); having fire or light, blazing, shining; (आन्), m. an epithet of Prācīna-barhis; (अती), f., N. of a wife of Priya-vrata and daughter of Viśva-karman; N. of a city in Brahmāvarta.
बर्हिष्क: बर्हिष्क, अस्, आ, अम्, formed of sacrificial grass; covered with sacrificial grass; a perfume commonly called Bāla, (perhaps a species of Andropogon); resin of Pinus Longifolia; (also written बर्हिस्क।)
बर्हिष्य: बर्हिष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. belonging to or fitted for sacrificial grass; कश्यपस्य बर्हिष्यम्, N. of a Sāman.
बल्: बल् 1. बल् [cf. rt. वल्], only occurring in Intens. बल्बलीति, &c., Ved. to whirl round in a circle.

बल् 2. बल् [cf. rt. भल्], cl. 1. P. ब-लति, बबाल, &c., to breathe, live; to hoard grain; to prevent or obstruct wealth; A. बलते, to speak; to hurt, to kill; to give, (in this sense a various reading for rt. भल्); to describe [cf. rt. भल्]; cl. 10. P. बलयति, -यितुम्, to breathe, live; बालयति, -यितुम्, to support, nourish, foster, cherish, bring up, rear; A. बालयते (a various reading for भालयते), to explain, describe.
बल: बल, अम्, n. (said to be also अस्, m.), power, strength, might, vigour, (औरसम् बलम्, native strength, innate power); force, violence, rigour, severity; force or power of articulation; force con-sidered as a sixth organ of action, (Mahā-bh. Śānti-p. 9895; cf. कर्मेन्द्रिय); (with Buddhists) one of ten forces; Power personified as one of the Viśve Devāḥ; massiveness, stoutness, bulkiness, weight; body, form, figure, shape; semen virile; military force, forces, troops, a host, army, (in these senses also pl.); gum, myrrh; blood; a sprout, young shoot; (अस्), m., N. of Bala-rāma the elder brother of Kṛṣṇa, also called Bala-deva, Bala-bhadra, &c.; (with Jainas) a white Bala or elder brother of Vāsu-deva, (nine of these are enumerated by Hemacandra, viz. Acala, Vijaya, Bhadra, Su-prabha, Su-darśana, Ānanda, Nandana, Padma, and Rāma); N. of a son of Varuṇa and brother of Surā; of an attendant on Skanda; of a son of Kṛṣṇa; of a son of Aṅgiras; of a son of Pari-kṣit; of a demon; of a lexicographer (also Vala); a species of carrion crow; a kind of tree, = 1. बलाय; (आ), f. an aquatic plant, a species of mallow, Sida Cordifolia; (बले, f. du. the two Balā plants, viz. Balā and Ati-balā, cf. अति-ब्°, ज्येष्ठ-ब्°); N. of a particular charm or incantation of great efficacy [cf. अति-बला]; N. of a woman; of a daughter of Dakṣa and wife of Kaśyapa; of a female divinity who executes the orders of the seventeenth Arhat of the present Ava-śarpiṇī; (अस्, आ, अम्), strong, stout, robust, powerful; sick (= अमिन्?); बलेन, ind. by force, by the power of, on the strength of; in virtue of, by means of, through, by; बलात्, ind. by force, forcibly, violently; against the will of, without the consent of; [cf. Lat. valor, validus, valeo, de-bilis.] —बल-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, or बल-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, inspiring or infusing strength, strengthening. —बल-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, done by force, done against free consent. —बल-कृति, इस्, f., Ved. a mighty deed. —बल-क्षोभ, अस्, m. a commotion in the forces, mutiny in an army. —बल-गुप्ता, f., N. of a woman. —बल-चक्र, अम्, n. ‘circle of power,’ dominion, sovereignty, supremacy; an army, host. —बल-चक्रवर्तिन्, ई, m. a powerful sovereign or emperor. —बल-चन्द्र, अस्, m., N. of a prince. —बल-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, produced by strength or power; (अम्), n. a city-gate, gate in general; a field; fruit, grain; war; a pretty figure; pith, marrow; (आ), f. a pretty or handsome woman; the earth; Arabian jasmine; N. of a river; (at the end of certain comps. बल-ज may optionally take Vṛddhi accord-ing to Pāṇ. VII. 3, 25, e. g. सौवर्ण-बलज or सौवर्ण-बालज।) —बल-द, अस्, m. ‘strength-giving,’ a form of Agni; an ox, bullock; a medicinal plant, = जीवक; (आ), f. the plant Phy-salis Flexuosa (= अश्व-गन्धा); N. of a daughter of Raudrāśva. —बल-दर्प, अस्, m. pride of strength; reckless ardour of troops. —बल-दा, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. ‘strength-giving,’ conferring or impart-ing power. —बलदी-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -भ-वितुम्, to become an ox. —बलदी-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, become an ox. —बल-देय, अम्, n., Ved. the granting of power, bestowal of strength, (Sāy. = बल-दान।) —बल-देव, अस्, m. air, wind; the elder brother of Kṛṣṇa, see बल-राम, (he is said in Mahā-bh. Ādi-p. 7308 to have been produced from a white hair of Viṣṇu, Kṛṣṇa having been produced from a black hair, and is regarded as a Nāga in Mahā-bh. Anuśāsana-p. 6163); N. of a Nāga-rāja; N. of a Brāhman; (आ), f. a species of medi-cinal plant (= त्रायमाणा). —बलदेव-पत्तन, अम्, n., N. of a city. —बलदेव-स्वसृ, सा, f. ‘sister of Bala-deva,’ an epithet of the wife of Śiva. —बल-द्विष्, ट्, m. ‘foe of the demon Bala,’ an epithet of Indra. —बल-धर, अस्, m., N. of a Brāhman; (आ), f., N. of the wife of Bhīma-sena. —बल-निग्रह, अस्, m. reducing strength, weak-ening. —बल-निसूदन, अस्, m. ‘destroyer of the demon Bala,’ Indra. —बल-पति, इस्, m. lord of strength; a general, commander; an epithet of Indra. —बल-प्रद, अस्, आ, अम्, giving strength. —बल-प्रसू, ऊस्, f. the mother of Bala-deva. Rohiṇī. —बल-प्राण, अम्, n. strength and spirit. —बल-बन्धु, उस्, m., N. of one of the sons of Manu Raivata; of a son of Bhṛgu in the tenth Dvāpara. —बल-भद्र, अस्, आ, अम्, strong, powerful; (अस्), m. a strong or robust man; a kind of ox, the gayal, Bos Gavæus (= गवय); the tree Symplocos Racemosa, com-monly called Lodh (= लोध्र); N. of Bala-rāma, q. v., or of An-anta, the great serpent identified with Bala-rāma; N. of a descendant of Bharata; N. of various men; N. of a mountain-range; (आ), f. a young girl, maiden; a species of medicinal plant (= त्रायमाणा). —बल-भद्रिका, f. a species of medicinal plant (= बल-भद्रा). —बल-भित्-सखि, आ, m. a friend of the slayer of Bala, friend of Indra. —बल-भिद्, त्, त्, त्, breaking up or routing an army; (त्), m. the slayer of Bala; an epithet of Indra. —बल-भृत्, त्, त्, त्, ‘might-bearing,’ power-ful, strong. —बल-राम, अस्, m., N. of the elder brother of Kṛṣṇa and third of the Rāmas, (seventh son of Vasu-deva and Devakī, but transferred to the womb of Rohiṇī; regarded as the eighth Avatār of Viṣṇu, sometimes as an incarnation of the great ser-pent Śeṣa or An-anta; he is also called Bala, Bala-deva, Bala-bhadra, and Halāyudha.) —बलराम-पञ्चानन, अस्, m., N. of a grammarian. —बल-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessing power, powerful, mighty, strong, stout, lusty; dense, thick; preponderating, prevailing; accompanied by an army; (आन्), m., N. of the eighth Muhūrta; (अत्), ind. powerfully, strongly, vehemently, stoutly, lustily, in a high degree, much, well. —बलवत्-तर, अस्, आ, अम्, more powerful, stronger. —बलवत्-ता, f. powerfulness, mightiness; superiority, preponderance. —बल-वर्धन, अस्, ई, अम्, increasing power, strengthening, ennobling; (अस्), m., N. of one of the sons of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra. —बल-वर्धिन्, ई, इनी, इ, increasing strength, strengthening; (इनी), f. a species of medicinal plant (= जीवक). —बल-वर्म-देव, अस्, m., N. of a king. —बल-वर्मन्, आ, m., N. of a prince; of a merchant. —बल-विज्ञाय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. recog-nizable by strength. —बल-विन्यास, अस्, m. ar-rangement or disposition of forces, array of troops. —बल-वीर्य, अस्, m., N. of a descendant of Bharata. —बलवीर्य-पराक्रम, अस्, आ, अम्, strong, heroic, and valorous. —बल-वृत्र-निसू-दन, अस्, or बल-वृत्र-हन्, हा, m. the destroyer of Bala and Vṛtra; an epithet of Indra. —बल-व्यसन, अम्, n. the defeat or rout of an army. —बलव्यसन-सङ्कुल, अस्, आ, अम्, (a king) embarassed by disorder in (his) army. —बल-शालि-ता, f. the possession of strength, prowess. —बल-शालिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having or possessing strength, strong, vigorous. —बल-सूदन, अस्, ई, अम्, destroying armies; (अस्), m. ‘destroyer of the demon Bala,’ Indra. —बल-सेन, अस्, m., N. of a warrior; (आ), f. a strong army, an army, host. —बल-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, strong, vigorous, powerful [cf. बलावस्थ]; (अस्), m. being in or belonging to an army, a warrior, soldier. —बल-स्थिति, इस्, f. ‘army-station,’ a camp, encampment; a royal residence, a royal camp or quarters. —बल-हन्, आ, घ्नी, अ, one who slays or destroys armies; (आ), m. ‘destroyer of strength,’ phlegm, the phlegmatic humor. —बल-हर, अस्, आ, अम्, taking away strength, depriving of power; (अस्), m., N. of a man. —बल-हीन, अस्, आ, अम्, destitute of strength, weak, infirm. —बलहीन-ता, f. the being destitute of strength, weakness, exhaustion, prostration of strength, infirmity from fatigue or age. —बलाक्ष (°ल-अक्°), अस्, m., N. of a prince. —बलाग्र (°ल-अग्°), अम्, n. the utmost strength, extreme force, excessive might; बलि: बलि बलि, इस्, m. (probably fr. rt. 2. बल्), tax, impost, tribute, royal revenue; an oblation, a gift or religious offering in general; the offering of a portion of the daily meal of ghee, grain, rice &c. to all creatures of every description, i. e. to gods, semi-divine beings, men, animals, and even trees &c., inanimate objects, but especially to those beings called गृह-देवताः or ‘household spirits,’ which were supposed to hover round and protect households, (this बलि, also called भूत-यज्ञ, q. v., was one of the five great sacrifices or religious rites, some-times called ‘sacraments,’ which Manu enjoins on every householder; cf. ब्रह्म-यज्ञ, देव-यज्ञ, पितृ-यज्ञ, मनुष्य-यज्ञ: it was performed by throwing up into the air, generally at the door of the house, the remains of the morning and evening meal, uttering at the same time a Mantra or prayer to some of the inferior deities, either to Indra and the Maruts or to Kuvera and his followers, the Guhyakas &c., or to the spirits of trees, waters &c.; the real consumers of the offering being the birds, dogs, insects &c. in the neighbourhood of the house; see Manu III. 67, 91, IV. 21); any oblation or act of worship not being a real sacrifice; fragments of food left at an oblation or a meal; a victim, any victim offered to Durgā; the handle of a chowrie or fly-flapper; three folds of skin at the end of the rectum; N. of a celebrated Daitya, a son of Virocana, and also called Mahā-bali, (he was the sovereign of Mahābali-pura, and so extended his empire as to acquire dominion over the three worlds; having omitted however in his arrogance to make the usual offerings to the deities, Viṣṇu resolved to mortify his pride, and assumed the form of a Vāmana or dwarf, as the son of Kaśyapa and Aditi and younger brother of Indra, in which shape he appeared before Bali and asked as much land as he could pace in three steps; this Bali granted, and Viṣṇu expanding himself deprived him in two steps of heaven and earth, but in consideration of his virtues left Pātāla or the lower regions still in his dominion; cf. त्रि-विक्रम); N. of Indra in the eighth Manv-antara; N. of a Muni; of a king; of a son of Su-tapas; (इस्, ई), f. a wrinkle, skin shrivelled by old age; the fold of skin in stout persons (especially females) upon the upper part of the belly or between the ensiform cartilage and the navel; बव: बव बव, अम्, n., N. of the first Karaṇa or astrological division of the day; (also written वव; see under करण।)
बष्कय: बष्कय बष्कय, अस्, आ, अम् (also written वष्कय, q. v.), Ved. one year old, a yearling, (Sāy. = either आदित्य, the sun, or एक-हायनो वत्-सः, a yearling calf); born later or after (?).
बष्कयणी: बष्कयणी (or वष्कयणी), f. a cow bearing many calves; a cow whose calf is full-grown.
बष्किह: बष्किह, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (according to Mahī-dhara) = चिर-प्रसूत।
बस्त: बस्त बस्त, अस्, m. (also written वस्त, q. v.), a goat. —बस्त-कर्ण, अस्, m. the Śāl tree, Shorea Robusta (= अज-कर्णक). —बस्त-गन्धा, f. shrubby basil, Ocymum Gratissimum (= अज-गन्-धा). —बस्तगन्धाकृति (°धा-आक्°), a species of plant (= पुत्र-दात्री). —बस्त-मुख, अस्, ई, अम्, ‘goat-faced,’ having a face like that of a goat. —बस्त-मूत्र, अम्, n. the urine of a goat. —बस्त-मोदा, f. ‘goat's delight,’ a species of plant (= अज-मोदा)। —बस्त-वासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, making a noise like a goat; (probably an incorrect form for बस्त-वाशिन्।) —बस्त-शृङ्गी, f. a species of plant (= मेष-शृङ्गी). —बस्तान्त्री (°त-अन्°), f. Argyreia Spe-ciosa or Argentea (= छगलान्त्री). —बस्ताभिवा-शिन् or बस्ताभिवासिन् (°त-अभ्°), ई, इनी, इ, Ved. = बस्त-वासिन्।
बस्रि: बस्रि बस्रि, ind., Ved. (according to Sāy.) = क्षिप्रम्, quickly, swiftly.
बह्: बह् बह् (another form of rt. बंह्), to grow, increase, &c. See rt. बंह्।
बहल: बहल, अस्, आ, अम्, hard, firm, compact; dense, thick (as any substance or as a liquid); harsh (as a sound); manifold, multifarious; (अस्), m. a kind of sugar-cane; (आ), f. Anethum Sowa (= शत-पुष्पा); large cardamoms. —बहल-गन्ध, अम्, n. a species of sandal (= शम्बर-चन्दन). —बहल-चक्षुस्, उस्, m. a species of plant (= मेष-शृङ्गी; also read चक्षुर्-बहल and चक्षुर्-वहन). —बहल-ता, f. thickness, density, compactness. —बहल-त्वच, अस्, m. the white flowering Lodhra. —बहल-वर्त्मन्, अ, n. a particular disease of the eyes, a swollen eyelid. —बहलाङ्ग = बहल-चक्षुस्, q. v. —बहलानुराग (°ल-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, deep red.
बहु: बहु, उस्, उस् or वी, उ (of rare occurrence in the first nine Maṇḍalas of the Ṛg-veda; frequently used in the Atharva-veda), much, abundant; many, nu-merous; frequent, repeated; abounding in, rich in (with inst., Ved.); large, great, mighty; fine, hand-some, splendid (Ved.); किम् बहुना, what occasion is there for much (speaking)? why say more? in short, in fine; बहु, ind. much, abundantly; in a high degree, greatly, exceedingly, very [cf. बहु-कल्याण, बहु-चित्र, बहु-सदृश]; rather, somewhat, very nearly, almost, (at the beginning of a comp.; cf. बहु-तृण, बहु-त्रिवर्ष); बहु मन्, to think much of, esteem highly, rate high, prize, value. —बहु-कण्टक, अस्, m. ‘many-thorned,’ N. of various prickly plants; a species of Asteracantha Lon-gifolia; Hedysarum Alhagi (= यवास); Phœnix Paludosa, = हिन्ताल; (आ), f. Solanum Jacquini (= अग्नि-दमनी). —बहु-कण्टा, f. ‘many-thorned,’ the plant Solanum Jacquini. —बहु-कन्द, अस्, m. ‘having many bulbous roots,’ the plant Arum Cam-panulatum; (ई), f. a species of plant (= कर्कटी)। —बहु-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, ‘much-doing,’ doing many things, busy, diligent; industrious, laborious; effect-ing much, serviceable in various ways; one who sweeps, a sweeper; (अस्), m. a camel; (ई), f. a broom. —बहु-करणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has much to do or complains he is full of business, one who never has time for anything; [cf. बहु-कृत्य।] —बहु-कर्णिका, f. = आखु-कर्णी, Salvinia Cucul-lata; [cf. बहु-पर्णिका।] —बहु-कल्याण, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, very illustrious, most noble. —बहु-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, having many wishes, cherish-ing many desires. —बहु-कार, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘much-doing,’ doing or effecting much. —बहु-कालम्, ind. for a long time, for a long while. —बहुकालीन, अस्, आ, अम्, of long standing, old, ancient. —बहु-कीट, अस्, m., N. of a Grāma in the north. —बहु-कुलीन or बहु-कुल्य, अस्, आ, अम्, see Scholiast on Pāṇ. IV. 1, 140; [cf. बाहु-कुलेयक।] —बहु-कुसुमित, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘many-blossomed,’ full of blossoms. —बहु-कूर्च, अस्, m. a species of cocoa-nut (= मधु-नालिकेरिक). —बहु-कृत्य, अस्, आ, अम्, = बहु-करणीय, q. v. —बहु-केतु, उस्, m., N. of a mountain. —बहु-क्रम, अस्, m., Ved. a Krama of more than three words; [cf. क्रम।] —बहु-क्षम, अस्, आ, अम्, enduring much, patient; (अस्), m. a Jaina deified saint; a Buddha. —बहु-क्षार, अस्, m. a kind of alkali (= सर्व-क्षार). —बहु-गन्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘much-smelling,’ strong scented; (अस्), m. the resin of Bos-wellia Thurifera, olibanum; (आ), f. a bud of Michelia Champaka; Jasminum Auriculatum; Nigella Indica = कृष्ण-जीरक; (अम्), n. cinnamon. —बहु-गन्ध-ता, f. musk. —बहु-गर्ह्य-वाच्, क्, क्, क्, saying much that is to be censured, talking much and blamably, too talkative, garrulous, loquacious. —ब-हु-गव, अस्, m. ‘having many kine,’ N. of a prince. —बहु-गिरि, इस्, N. of a district. —बहु-गुडा, f. the plant Solanum Jacquini. —बहु-गुण, अस्, आ, अम्, many-threaded, composed of many threads; manifold, multifarious, much; having many good qualities, possessed of many virtues; (अस्), m., N. of a Deva-gandharva, (Mahā-bh. Ādi-p. 4814, where however बहु-गुण is more probably an adj. in the last of the preceding senses.) —बहु-गुरु, उस्, m. one who has read much but superficially (= चुम्-बक). —बहु-गुहा, f. = बहु-गुडा. —बहु-गो, गौस्, गौस्, गु, having much cattle. —बहु-ग्रन्थि, इस्, m. ‘many-knotted,’ the plant Tamarix Indica. —बहु-ग्रह, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘much-receiving,’ receiving or taking much, holding much. —बहु-चारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, Ved. ‘much-wandering,’ roaming widely. —बहु-चित्र, अस्, आ, अम्, very various or manifold. —बहु-च्छद, अस्, m. the plant Alstonia Scholaris (= सप्त-पर्ण). —बहु-च्छिन्ना, f. a species of plant (= कन्द-गुडूची). —बहु-जन्य, अम्, n. (?), a multitude of people. —बहु-जल्प, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘much-talking,’ very talkative, loqua-cious. —बहु-जव, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. very swift, (a word used in Nirukta XII. 43 to explain उरु-ज्रि, q. v.) —बहु-जात, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. grown mighty, (a word used in Nirukta XII. 36 to explain तुवि-जात, q. v.) —बहु-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘much-know-ing,’ possessed of great knowledge. —बहुज्ञ-ता, f. great knowledge. —बहु-तन्त्रि, इस्, ईस्, इ, many-fibred (said only of the body, Pāṇ. बहुधा: बहु-धा, ind. in many ways, variously, mani-foldly, multifariously; in various parts, in different forms; in many places, in various directions; much, repeatedly; बहुधा कृ, to make manifold, mul-tiply; to make public, divulge. —बहुधा-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, gone in various directions, dispersed, scattered. —बहुधात्मक (°धा-आत्°), अस्, इका, अम्, existing in various forms, manifold in essence.
बहुर: बहुर = बहुल in the comp. बहुर-मध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. thick in the middle (said of the Soma juice during the process of fermentation); (Sāy.) = बहुलम् अङ्गादिकम् अनुष्ठानम् म-ध्ये प्रारम्भ-समाप्त्य्-अन्तराले यस्य।
बहुल: बहुल, अस्, आ, अम्, thick, dense, compact, solid; broad, wide, wide-spread, spacious; capacious, ample, large; abundant, exceeding, numerous, manifold, many, much; abounding in, rich in, full of (with inst. or in comp.; cf. व्याधि-ब्°); accompanied by, attended with; variously applicable, comprehensive (as a rule); born under the Pleiades; black; (अस्), m. the dark half of a month; Agni or fire; N. of a Prajā-pati; of a king of the Tāla-jaṅghas; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people; (आ), f. a cow; cardamoms; the indigo plant; N. of the twelfth Kalā of the moon; of a goddess; of one of the Mātṛs attending on Skanda; of the wife of Uttama who was son of Uttāna-pāda; of a mythical cow; of a river; (आस्), f. pl. = कृत्तिकास्, the Pleiades; (अम्), n. the sky, air; white pepper; a particular high number; (अम्), ind. often, frequently. —बहुल-गन्धा, f. ‘richly-scented,’ cardamoms. —बहुल-च्छद, अस्, m. a red-flowering Hyperanthera Moringa (= रक्त-शिग्रु). —बहुल-तर, अस्, आ, अम्, thicker, denser; द्वि-गुणो बहुलतरः, twice as thick. —बहुल-ता, f. or बहुल-त्व, अम्, n. muchness, multiplicity, abundance, numerousness; the being rich in, abounding in, (at the end of a comp.); compre-hensiveness. —बहुल-वर्मन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. en-veloped in a thick covering. —बहुलान्त (°ल-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. ‘thick at the end,’ having a thick sediment (as Soma juice; cf. बहुर-मध्य). —बहुलाभिमान (°ल-अभ्°), अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. much threatening, menacing (said of Indra; according to Sāy. = महानुभाव). —बहुलालाप (°ल-आल्°), ‘much-talking,’ talkative, garrulous, loquacious. —ब-हुलाविष्ट (°ल-आव्°), अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. thickly peopled, densely populated. —बहुलाश्व (°ल-अश्°), अस्, m. ‘having many horses,’ N. of a king. —ब-हुली-करण, अम्, n. multiplying, magnifying; win-nowing (for फली-करण?). —बहुली-करिष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, striving or endeavouring to increase. —ब-हुली-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, -कर्तुम्, to make wide, extend; to increase, aggrandize; to make public, pro-mulgate, divulge. —बहुली-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, made much or manifold; made wide, extended; increased, augmented, aggrandized; made public, promulgated; distracted; threshed, winnowed (for फली-कृत?). —बहुली-भाव, अस्, m. the becoming wide-spread, becoming public, being generally known, general no-toriety. —बहुली-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -भवितुम्, to become wide-spread, spread, increase (intrans.); to become public, to become generally known. —ब-हुली-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, become wide-spread, spread, increased; become public, generally known.
बहुलक: बहुलक, an incorrect form for बाहुलक, q. v.
बहुलिका: बहुलिका, आस्, f. pl. the Pleiades (= बहुलास्).
बहुशस्: बहु-शस्, ind. much, abundantly, plentifully, nu-merously, in great numbers; manifoldly; frequently, repeatedly; generally, commonly, for the most part.
बहि: बहि बहि, इस्, m., N. of a Piśāca.
बहिस्: बहिस् बहिस्, ind. (in the later language more usually वहिस्, q. v.; the final स् is changed before क् and प् into ष् according to Pāṇ. VIII. 3, 41), out, without, outside (a house, village, city, kingdom, &c., with abl.); on the outside, outwards, out-of-doors; वहिर् गम्, वहिर् या, &c., to go out; राष्ट्राद् or विषयाद् वहिष् कृ, to place outside the king-dom, banish from the realm. —बहिः-सद्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. sitting outside (said of a person held in low esteem). —बहिर्-धा, ind., Ved. outside, on the outside, to the outside of (with abl.). —बहिर्धा-भाव, अस्, m., Ved. the being outside, being ex-ternal. —बहिर्-वेदि, ind., Ved. outside the Vedi, without the Vedi or altar; [cf. वहिर्-वेदि, वहिर्-वेदिक, and वाहिर्वेदिक।] —बहिष्-परिधि, ind., Ved. outside the wooden frame called Pari-dhi, q. v. —बहिष्-पवमान, अम्, n. (scil. स्तो-त्रम्), Ved., N. of a morning Stotra commonly consisting of three Tricas and sung outside the Vedi (e. g. the verses in Ṛg-veda IX. 11, 1-9); (अस्), m. the morning Stoma; (ई), f. (scil. स्तोत्रिया, i. e. ऋच्), the morning prayer. —बहिष्-पवित्र, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. destitute of or wanting the Pavitra. —ब-हिष्-पिण्ड, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having the knots out-wards. —बहिष्-प्रज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. one whose knowledge is directed towards external objects. —ब-हिष्-प्राण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. one whose breath or life is without; [cf. वहिष्-प्राण।] —बही-रज्जु, ind., Ved. outside the rope.
बहीनर: बहीनर बहीनर, अस्, m. (also written व-हीनर), N. of a man; of a prince; of a grandson of Śatānīka.
बहुरद: बहुरद बहुरद, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people; (also read बाहुबाध।)
बह्रामखान: बह्रामखान बह्रामखान, अस्, m. = بهرام خان
बह्लि: बह्लि बह्लि, बह्लिक, बह्लीक, various read-ings for बल्हि, बल्हिक, बल्हीक, q. q. v. v.
बाकुर: बाकुर बाकुर, अस्, m., Ved., scil. दृति, (perhaps) a kind of bag-pipe.
बाजबाहादुरचन्द्र: बाजबाहादुरचन्द्र बाज-बाहादुर-चन्द्र, अस्, m., N. of a prince who was the patron of Ananta-deva the author of the Vyavahāra-dīdhiti, a work on civil law.
बाड्: बाड् बाड् (according to Vopa-deva वाड्), cl. 1. A. बाडते, बाडितुम्, to bathe, dive; to emerge; [cf. Gr. Βαλανεῖον: Lat. balneum: Old Germ. bad, ‘a bath;’ badôn, ‘to bathe.’]
बाडीर: बाडीर बाडीर, अस्, m. a servant, a hired labourer.
बाढ: बाढ बाढ, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. बह् or बंह्; frequently also written वाढ, q. v.; according to Pāṇ. V. 3, 63, the compar. is साधीयस् and superl. साधिष्ठ), loud, strong; (ए), ind. loudly, strongly, (according to Sāy. = दृढ, स्थिर); (अम्), ind. (almost always written वाढम्), much, exceed-ingly; assuredly, certainly; (as a particle expres-sive of consent, affirmation, and confirmation), be it so, good, very well, such is the case, yes. —बाढ-सृत्वन्, आ, m., Ved. going mightily, rushing fearlessly (Sāy. = भृशं सर्ता = अशङ्-कित-गमन).
बाण: बाण बाण, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. बण् or वण्, to sound; in the later language more usually written वाण, q. v.), a reed-shaft, shaft made of a reed, an arrow. —बाण-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. made or consisting of reeds, reeden, reedy; (आन्), m. ‘con-taining reed-shafts,’ a quiver; an arrow.
बाणिज: बाणिज बाणिज, अस्, m. (fr. बणिज्), a mer-chant, trader; (also written वाणिज।)
बाणिजिक: बाणिजिक, अस्, m. a trader, merchant; a rogue, cheat; submarine fire.
बाणिज्य: बाणिज्य, अम्, n. merchandize, trade, traffic, com-merce.
बादर: बादर बादर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. बदर), be-longing to or derived from the jujube tree; made of cotton; (अस्, आ), m. f. the cotton shrub; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people; (अम्), n. the jujube (= ब-दर); the berry of Abrus Precatorius; the plant itself; = वीर, (probably) a species of plant; silk; water; a conch shell which winds in a direction from left to right.
बादरायण: बादरायण, अस्, m. (a patronymic fr. बदर), N. of a sage (said to be the author of the Śārīraka-sūtras belonging to the Uttara-mīmāṃsā or Vedānta philosophy and identified with Vyāsa, the reputed compiler of the Vedas, Mahā-bhārata, Purāṇas, &c.; also written वादरायण); N. of an astronomer; of the author of a Dharma-śāstra; (अस्, ई, अम्), composed by Bādarāyaṇa. —बादरायण-सूत्र, अम्, n., N. of the Vedānta aphorisms ascribed to Bādarāyaṇa.
बादरायणि: बादरायणि, इस्, m. a patronymic of Śuka, son of Bādarāyaṇa or Vyāsa; a N. of Vyāsa.
बादरि: बादरि, इस्, m., Ved. (a patronymic fr. बदर), N. of a philosophical teacher mentioned in the Bā-darāyaṇa-sūtras.
बादरिक: बादरिक, अस्, ई, अम्, one who gathers the fruit of the jujube tree.
बाध्: बाध् बाध्, cl. 1. A. (in poetry some-times also P.) बाधते (-ति), बबाधे (बबाध), बाधिष्यते, अबाधिष्ट, बाधितुम्, to press, press hard, oppress, harass, pain, torment; to give trouble, trouble, grieve, vex, disturb, disquiet (with acc. or gen.); to resist, oppose, thwart, check, obstruct, stop, arrest, prevent; to attack, assault, assail; to injure, wrong, violate; to hurt, damage; to drive away, chase away, repel, remove; to sus-pend, set aside (as a rule in grammar), invalidate, abolish, annul; to clash, mutually oppose each other; to suffer annoyance or oppression (Ved.); to thrust apart (Ved.): Pass. बाध्यते, to be oppressed, pained, &c., to suffer pain: Caus. बाधयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अबबाधत्, to oppress, annoy, harass, distress, afflict, pain; to overcome, subdue, conquer: Desid. बि-बाधिषते, बीभत्सते, Ved. to feel an aversion from, feel disgust or loathing for, have a horror of (with abl.): Intens. बाबाध्यते, बाबाद्धि, (probably the Ved. form बद्बधे, which according to Sāy. is fr. rt. बन्ध्, belongs to this Intens. with the following senses), to reduce to great straits, hem in, confine, cramp; to strike or knock against (for want of room, Ṛg-veda VII. 69, 1); [cf. Zend vad, ‘to strike;’ vaday, ‘to strike back:’ Gr. ἔπαθον, ὠθ-έ-ω, ἐν-οσί-χθων, ἐνν-οσί-γαιο-ς: Lat. ôd-i, ŏ-d-i-um: Russ. bjeda = Lith. bêda, ‘misery:’ Lith. bêdnas, ‘miserable:’ perhaps Goth. balvja, ‘I trouble,’ fr. badvja: perhaps Hib. buairim, ‘I vex, aggrieve, trouble,’ fr. buaidim.]
बाध: बाध, अस्, आ, m. f. pain, suffering, trouble, sorrow, affliction; annoyance, molestation [cf. भ्रमर-ब्°]; resistance, opposition, obstruction; injury, de-triment, hurt, damage; violation, infraction; sus-pension, annulment (of a rule); danger, peril, jeopardy [cf. प्राण-ब्°]; a contradiction, absurdity, reductio ad absurdum; (अस्), m. a harasser, tormentor (Ved., cf. तुवि-ब्°); opposing, opposition, hinderance, ob-struction, obstacle, oppression; objection; one of the five forms of fallacious middle term, the being precluded by superior proof; (according to Naigh. II. 9) = बल; (आ), f. refutation. —बाध-रहस्य, अम्, n. or बाध-बुद्धि-प्रतिबन्धकता-विचार, or बाध-बुद्धि-वादार्थ, अस्, m., N. of a Nyāya work by Hari-rāma Tarka-vāg-īśa Bhaṭṭācārya. —बा-धापवाद (°ध-अप्°), अस्, m. denial of an excep-tion, re-establishing a previous rule.
बाधक: बाधक, अस्, इका, अम्, oppressing, harassing, paining [cf. शत्रु-ब्°]; one who hinders or opposes, a hinderer; suspending, setting aside (as a rule in grammar); invalidating, annulling, neutralizing; (अस्), m. a particular disease of women; a species of tree (= गिरि-माल, राज-वृक्ष); (अस्, ई, अम्), be-longing to or derived from the preceding tree. —बाधक-ता, f. or बाधक-त्व, अम्, n. the being a hinderer, hinderance.
बाधन: बाधन, अस्, ई, अम्, pressing hard, harassing, opposing; refuting; (आ), f. uneasiness, uncomfort-ableness, trouble, pain; (अम्), n. oppression, the act of harassing, annoying, paining, pain; opposing, hindering; precluding; suspending, removing, setting aside (a rule), annulling, abolishing; refutation.
बाधमान: बाधमान, अस्, आ, अम्, oppressing, harassing, paining, annoying.
बाधित: बाधित, अस्, आ, अम्, pressed hard, oppressed, harassed, pained, tormented; resisted, opposed, ob-structed, hindered, impeded, thwarted, checked; self-refuted, refuted; set aside, suspended (as a rule), abolished; (in logic) contradictory, absurd, false, in-compatible. —बाधित-त्व, अम्, n. the being sus-pended or set aside (as a rule), suspension, abolition; the state of being refuted or contradicted.
बाधितव्य: बाधितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be pressed hard, to be harassed or annoyed, to be pained; to be suspended or set aside, to be annulled; to be removed.
बाधितृ: बाधितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who presses hard, an oppressor, harasser, annoyer.
बाधित्वा: बाधित्वा, ind. having pressed hard or harassed; (in grammar) destroying or neutralizing the effect of a previous rule.
बाध्य: बाध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be pressed hard or harassed or distressed, to be pained [cf. स्त्री-ब्°]; one who is harassed or pained; to be hindered or resisted, to be objected to or opposed, objectionable, exceptionable; to be suspended or annulled; preventable; suppressed, obstructed. —बाध्य-बाधक-ता, f. the condition of oppressed and oppressor. —बाध्य-रेतस्, आस्, m. one whose generative power is obstructed, impotent.
बाध्यमान: बाध्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being pressed hard or oppressed, being harassed or beset, being tormented. —बाध्यमान-त्व, अम्, n. the being suspended or set aside, suspension, annulment.
बाधिरक: बाधिरक बाधिरक (fr. बधिर), see Gaṇa Arīhaṇādi to Pāṇ. IV. 2, 80.
बाधिरिक: बाधिरिक, अस्, m. a metronymic from Badhirikā.
बाध्योग: बाध्योग बाध्योग, अस्, m. a patronymic from Badhyoga.
बाध्योगायण: बाध्योगायण, अस्, m. a patronymic from Bā-dhyoga.
बान्धकिनेय: बान्धकिनेय बान्धकिनेय, अस्, m. (fr. बन्-धकी), the son of an unmarried woman, a bastard.
बान्धव: बान्धव बान्धव, अस्, m. (fr. बन्धु), a relation (near or remote and including wives and chil-dren), relative, kinsman [cf. पितृ-ब्°]; a maternal relation; a friend [cf. पिक-ब्°]; (ई), f. a female rela-tion. —बान्धव-कर, अस्, m. an epithet of Lallā-dīkṣita, a commentator on the Mṛc-chakaṭī. —बान्-धव-त्याग, अस्, m. abandoning a kinsman, for-saking a relation. —बान्धवाक्रोशिन् (°व-आक्°), ई, इनी, इ, calling out to or bewailing a kinsman.
बान्धवक: बान्धवक, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging or relating to kinsmen, kindred.
बान्धव्य: बान्धव्य, अम्, n. connection by blood, relation-ship, consanguinity.
बान्धुक: बान्धुक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. बन्धुक), belonging to or derived from the Bandhuka tree.
बान्धुपत: बान्धुपत, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. बन्धु-पति), re-lating to the lord of kindred or relations.
बापय: बापय बापय, अस्, m. surname of the scribe Kāśī-nātha-bhaṭṭa.
बाप्यदेव: बाप्यदेव बाप्य-देव, अस्, m., N. of the writer of a particular inscription.
बाबजीव्यास: बाबजीव्यास बाबजी-व्यास, अस्, m., N. of an author.
बाबर: बाबर बाबर, अम्, n. (fr. बबर), epithet of a Pañca-rātra; N. of a place.
बाबेरी: बाबेरी बाबेरी, f., N. of a city.
बाभ्रव: बाभ्रव बाभ्रव, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. बभ्रु), belonging or relating to Babhru; (अस्), m. a patro-nymic from Babhru; (ई), f. an epithet of Durgā (the wife of Babhru, i. e. Śiva).
बाभ्रवायणि: बाभ्रवायणि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Bā-bhrava; N. of a son of Viśvā-mitra.
बाभ्रवीय: बाभ्रवीय, आस्, m. pl. (fr. बाभ्रव्य), the disciples or followers of Bābhravya.
बाभ्रव्य: बाभ्रव्य, अस्, m. a patronymic from Babhru; N. of a teacher.
बाभ्रव्यक: बाभ्रव्यक, अस्, ई, अम्, inhabited by Bābhravyas.
बाभ्रुक: बाभ्रुक, अस्, ई, अम्, like an ichneumon, (i. e. probably) brown, brownish.
बार: बार बार, Ved. an opening, aperture; [cf. जिह्म-ब्°, नीचीन-ब्°।]
बारहट: बारहट बारहट, अस्, m. epithet of Nara-hara-dāsa the author of the Hindī work Avatāra-caritra or Caturviṃsaty-avatāra-caritra.
बारेज्य: बारेज्य बारेज्य, N. of a town.
बार्बटीर: बार्बटीर बार्बटीर or बार्वटीर, अस्, m. the kernel of the mango fruit; a young shoot; tin; the son of a harlot; [cf. बर्बटी।]
बार्हत: बार्हत बार्हत, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. बृहत्), Ved. relating to the Sāman called Bṛhat, celebrated in the Bṛhat-sāman, (according to Mahī-dhara = बृहत्-साम-स्तुत); relating or belonging to the Bṛhatī metre, representing it, consisting of it; बार्हतं वाजजिदौक्ष्णोरन्ध्रम्, N. of a Sāman; (अम्), n. the fruit of the Bṛhatī, a variety of the So-lanum.
बार्हतानुष्टुभ: बार्हतानुष्टुभ, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. बृहत् + अनु-ष्टुभ्), Ved. consisting of a Bṛhatī and an Anu-ṣṭubh.
बार्हत्सामा: बार्हत्सामा, f. (fr. बृहत्-सामन्), Ved., N. or epithet of a woman.
बार्हदग्न: बार्हदग्न, आस्, m. pl. (fr. बृहद्-अग्नि), the descendants of Bṛhad-agni.
बार्हदीषव: बार्हदीषव, अस्, m. a patronymic from Bṛhad-ishu (with इ lengthened).
बार्हदुक्थ: बार्हदुक्थ, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. relating or be-longing to Bṛhad-uktha; (अस्), m. a patronymic from Bṛhad-uktha.
बार्हद्गिर: बार्हद्गिर, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. relating or belong-ing to Bṛhad-giri.
बार्हद्दैवत: बार्हद्दैवत, अम्, n. (fr. बृहद्-देवता), N. of a work also called Bṛhad-devatā and attributed to Śaunaka.
बार्हद्बल: बार्हद्बल, अस्, ई, अम्, relating or belonging to Bṛhad-bala.
बार्हद्रथ: बार्हद्रथ, अस्, ई, अम्, relating or belonging to Bṛhad-ratha; (अस्), m. a patronymic of Jarā-sandha; (sometimes spelt बारहद्रथ।)
बार्हद्रथि: बार्हद्रथि, इस्, m. (fr. बृहद्-रथ), a patro-nymic of Jarā-sandha.
बार्हवत: बार्हवत, अस्, ई, अम्, containing the word बर्ह-वत्।
बार्हस्पत: बार्हस्पत, अस्, ई, अम्, relating or belonging to Bṛhas-pati, descended from Bṛhas-pati, sacred to Bṛhas-pati.
बार्हस्पत्य: बार्हस्पत्य, अस्, ती, अम्, relating to or coming from Bṛhas-pati; (अस्), m. a pupil of Bṛhas-pati; an infidel, a materialist; an epithet of Śamyu; of Agni; of Tapur-mūrdhan; of Bharad-vāja; (अम्), n., scil. भ or नक्षत्र, the constellation Puṣya; the Artha-śāstra of Bṛhas-pati, ethics, morality; बार्हस्पत्यम् मानम्, ‘Jupiter's measure of time,’ a method of reckoning time. —बार्हस्पत्य-ज्योतिर्-ग्रन्थ, अस्, m., N. of a work mentioned in Raghu-nandana's Saṃskāra-tattva. —बार्हस्प-त्य-तन्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a Tantra mentioned in the Ānanda-laharī.
बार्हिषद: बार्हिषद बार्हिषद, अस्, m. a patronymic from Barhiṣad.
बाल्: बाल् बाल्, ind., Ved. an interjection imi-tative of the sound of a falling body.
बाल: बाल बाल, अस्, आ, अम् (said to be fr. rt. 2. बल्), young, childish, infantine, immature, not full-grown; newly risen (as the sun, cf. बालातप, बाला-दित्य, बालार्क), new or waxing (as the moon, cf. बाल-चन्द्र, बालेन्दु); puerile, ignorant, un-wise, uninstructed; pure (said especially of a female animal, as a heifer &c., fit for sacrifice); (अस्, आ), m. f. a child (especially one under five years of age, but also one under sixteen years of age generally), an infant; (in law) a minor (who is distinguished as a कुमार or boy under five years of age; शिशु, a boy under eight; पोगण्ड, a boy from the fifth to the end of the ninth year, or where the next distinction is omitted, till the sixteenth year; and किशोर, a boy from the tenth to the sixteenth year); the young of an animal, a five years old elephant [cf. बाल-गज]; a colt, foal; one whose under-standing is not matured, a simpleton, fool; a tail, an elephant or horse's tail; hair; (अस्, अम्), m. n. a kind of perfume or fragrant grass, Andropogon Schœnanthus; (अस्), m. a boy; a kind of fish, Cyprinus Denticulatus or Cyprinus Rohita; N. of a prince; (आ), f. a female child, girl, young woman not more than sixteen years of age; a woman, female; small cardamoms [cf. चन्द्र-ब्°]; Aloe Indica [cf. घृत-कुमारी]; a species of plant, com-monly called Aknadhi; a variety of jasmine; a species of flower, Hibiscus Tortuosus; the cocoa-nut; turmeric; a kind of metre, the quantities of the first three lines being ˘¯˘¯¯˘˘¯˘¯¯ and that of the fourth ¯¯˘¯¯ &c.; N. of the mother of Bālin and Sugrīva, (she is said to have been formed by Prajā-pati out of some dust which had fallen into his eyes); N. of a mystical prayer; (ई), f. a kind of ear-ring; [cf. Lith. wála-s, ‘horsehair.’] —बाल-कदली, f. a young plantain tree, Musa Sapientum. —बाल-काण्ड, अम्, n. ‘section treating of the boy (Rāma),’ N. of the first book of the Rāmāyaṇa according to the northern recension (called Ādi-kāṇḍa in the Bengālī recension); N. of the first book of the Adhyātma-rāmāyaṇa. —बाल-कुन्द, अस्, अम्, m. n. a young jasmine of the variety Jasminum Multi-florum or J. Pubescens. —बालकुन्दानुविद्ध (°द-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, adorned with young jasmine blossoms. —बाल-कृमि, इस्, m. ‘hair-insect,’ a louse. —बाल-कृष्ण, अस्, m. the boy Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa as a boy; N. of various men; N. of the father of the author Śaṅkara-dīkṣita; of a friend of Maṇi-rāma (a commentator on the Bhāminī-vilāsa); of the father of Mahā-deva (the author of the Nyāya-sid-dhānta-muktāvalī-dīpikā, a commentary on the Bhā-ṣā-pariccheda); of a son of Mahādeva-bhaṭṭa and husband of Lakṣmī-devī; of a son of Raṅga-nātha and father of Nārāyaṇa (a commentator on the Uttara-rāma-carita); of the father of Raṅga-nātha and Veṇī-mādhava-bandhu; of a man called also Gaṅgā-dhara. —बाल-क्रिया, f. children's act, the actions or con-duct of children. —बाल-क्रीडन, अम्, n. child's play, childish amusement. —बाल-क्रीडनक, अस्, m. a child's toy or plaything, a ball; the plant Cypræa Moneta; an epithet of Śiva; (अम्), n. child's play, childish sports; (आनि), n. pl., N. of the sixty-first chapter of the third part of Vātsyāyana's Kāma-sūtra. —बाल-क्रीडा, f. child's play, children's amusements, childish sport, juvenile pastime. —बा-लक्रीडा-वर्णन, अम्, n., N. of the eleventh book of the Kumāra-sambhava. —बाल-खिल्य, अस्, m. [cf. वाल-खिल्य], a divine personage of the size of a thumb, (sixty thousand were produced from Brah-ma's body, and surround the chariot of the Sun; see Raghu-vaṃśa XV. 10; Wilson's Viṣṇu-Purāṇa, p. 34.) —बाल-गज, अस्, m. a young elephant. —बाल-गर्भिणी, f. a cow with calf for the first time. —बाल-गादा-धरी, f., N. of a work by Annam Bhaṭṭa (= तर्क-दीपिका). —बाल-गोपाल, अस्, m. ‘the boy cowherd,’ Kṛṣṇa as a youthful herdsman. —बालगोपाल-तीर्थ, अस्, m., N. of the teacher of the commentator Dhana-pati. —बाल-गोपाल-यतीन्द्र (°ति-इन्°), अस्, m., N. of the scho-liast on Śaṅkara's commentary to the Kaṭhopaniṣad. —बाल-गौरी-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a sacred bath-ing-place in Śrī-māla. —बाल-ग्रह, अस्, m. ‘seizer of children,’ a kind of demon (to whom nine kinds of demoniacal possessions are ascribed); any demon who delights in teasing and injuring children. —बा-लग्रह-प्रतिषेध, अम्, n., N. of a chapter of Vāgbhaṭa's Aṣṭāṅga-hṛdaya-saṃhitā. —बालग्र-होपशमन (°ह-उप्°), अम्, n., N. of a chapter of the Śārṅga-dhara-paddhati. —बाल-घ्न, अस्, m. a child-slayer, one who has killed a child, the murderer of a child; (ई), f. a murderess of children (said of a Rākṣasī). —बाल-चन्द्र, अस्, or बाल-चन्द्रमस्, आस्, m. the young or waxing moon (= बालेन्दु); a term for the moon till five or six days old. —बालचन्द्रिका, f., N. of a woman. —बाल-चरित or बाल-चरित्र, अम्, n. ‘childish exploits,’ juvenile sports or pastime; a common N. of works or sections of works treating of the youthful adventures of a deity; N. of a chapter of the Gaṇeśa-Purāṇa. —बालचरित-नामन्, N. of a work by Vallabha-dīkṣita containing the titles of Kṛṣṇa derived from 128 of his youthful adventures. —बाल-चर्य, अस्, m. ‘behaving like a child,’ an epithet of Kārttikeya; (आ), f. the conduct or behaviour of a child. —बाल-चूत, अस्, m. a young mango tree. —बाल-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, springing or produced from hair; (in Mahā-bh. Anuśāsana-p. 1611, 4587, a wrong reading for बाल्बज, q. v.) —बाल-तनय, अस्, m. a young son; the tree Acacia Catechu. —बाल-तन्त्र, अम्, n. midwifery, the care of a lying-in woman and of her child. —बाल-तरु, उस्, m. a young tree. —बाल-ता, f. or बाल-त्व, अम्, n. childhood, boyhood. —बाल-तृण, अम्, n. young grass. —बालदलक, अस्, m. ‘small-leafed,’ the tree Acacia Catechu; [cf. बाल-पत्त्र।] —बाल-देव, अस्, m., N. of the father of Bāvā-deva, q. v. —बाल-धन, अम्, n. the property of a minor or infant. —बाल-धि, इस्, m. a hairy tail (as that of a horse). —बाल-पण्डित, अस्, m., N. of a man. —बाल-पत्त्र or बाल-पत्-त्रक, अस्, m. ‘small-leafed,’ Acacia Catechu (= बालदलक); Hedysarum Alhagi. —बाल-पाद-प, अस्, m. a young tree. —बाल-पाश्या, f. an orna-ment (of gold, silver, &c.) worn between the hair when parted on the forehead; a string of pearls binding the hair. —बाल-पुत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, having little children, possessing very young children; pos-sessed of young offspring. —बाल-पुत्रक, अस्, m. a little son. —बाल-पुष्पिका, f. a variety of jas-mine (= यूथिका). —बाल-पुष्पी, f. a variety of jasmine, Jasminum Auriculatum. —बाल-बन्धन, अस्, m., Ved. ‘child-fetterer,’ N. of a demon. —बाल-बोध, अस्, m. ‘instruction for the youthful,’ N. of various works adapted to the capacity of the young or inexperienced; of a commentary by the mathe-matician Go-vinda the son of Lāḍama on a Nyāya work by Śāṇḍilya; of a work by Vallabha Ācārya on devotion to Kṛṣṇa. —बाल-बोधक, अस्, ई, अम्, instructing the youthful and inexperienced, en-lightening the simple. —बाल-बोधनी, f. ‘instruct-ing the youthful,’ N. of a Vedānta work. —बाल-बोधिनी, f. ‘instructing the youthful,’ N. of a com-mentary by an anonymous Vedānta writer on the Vākya-sudhā; N. of a work by Śaṅkarācarya said to epitomize the logical portions of the Śārīraka-mīmāṃsā-bhāṣya. —बालबोधिनी-भाव-प्रका-शिका, f., N. of a commentary on Śaṅkara Ācārya's Bāla-bodhinī. —बाल-भञ्जक, अस्, m., N. of a man. —बाल-भद्रक, अस्, m. a kind of mineral poison (= शाम्भव). —बाल-भार, अस्, m. ‘a weight of tail,’ a large bushy tail. —बाल-भारत, अम्, n. ‘the little Bhārata,’ (opposed to the Mahā-bhārata or great Bhārata), N. of a work ascribed to Amara-candra (being a compendium of the Mahā-bhārata);
